Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The
patient reported immediate onset of neck pain and stiffness, and the mechanism of injury is consistent with the
reported symptoms. Over the course of 19 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual
therapy, stretching and strengthening exercises, and home exercise instruction. The treatment course followed a
typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as the patient's range of motion and pain levels improved.
Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a cervical strain consistent with the collision. No prior injury
or treatment to the cervical spine has been reported or identified in the records reviewed. Billing records reflect single
charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed. The patient was discharged from
active care in stable condition with instructions to continue the home exercise program as needed.
